en.html:
Toward the place in the message.
Run. Run. Run.

Time had passed. Too much time had bloody passed. How many hours now since Muramasa was taken?

The sun was sinking. Red was beginning to spread through the sky.

She was safe. Still safe. She had to be.
Whatever Sorimachi wanted, surely he had no need to kill her.

So she was safe.
That was what I would believe.

Even if I still could not contact her. Even if I called and called and nothing came back.

She was alive.
She had to be. Surely. Absolutely.

Then hurry. Not even one second to waste. Get to Muramasa. Get her out.

Run—

en.html:
Nothing but wasteland. Grass growing any which way, stones big and small lying everywhere.

Among them, like one more dead tree, stood Ichizo Sorimachi.

He lifted himself from the rock where he had been sitting and took a few steps toward me.

There he stopped.
en.text:
Nothing but wasteland. Grass growing any which way, stones big and small lying everywhere.

Among them, like one more dead tree, stood Ichizo Sorimachi.

He lifted himself from the rock where he had been sitting and took a few steps toward me.

There he stopped.

Sorimachi's fist dug into my cheek. A whole storm of sparks in my eyes.

So what.
The impact went right down to my knees. Let it.
I hit him back.

ja.html:
その出鼻に、叩き込まれた。
　雪車町の拳が俺の頬を抉り、視界が火花の渦と化す。

　構わない。
　膝にまで響く打撃を無視して、返しの一撃。

en.html:
He staggered a few steps.
Still the bastard would not fall.

He caught both my shoulders and pulled me in with strength I could hardly believe. His knee drove into my stomach.

ja.html:
数歩、たたらを踏み。
　それでも雪車町は倒れなかった。

　俺の両肩を掴んで、信じ難い剛力で引き込み、腹に
膝頭を突き入れてくる。

en.html:
Bitter fluid surged up my throat and filled my mouth.
I vomited.

Sorimachi drove his elbow into my back. Again and again. Each sharp blow bent my spine.

　吐く。

　更に雪車町は、俺の背へ肘を打った。
　連続して。鋭い衝撃に背骨が歪む。

I roared.
Still doubled over, I put every scrap of strength into it.

No finesse. A throw by main force.
I dragged Sorimachi down onto the ground.

吼えた。
　前屈した体勢のまま、死力を尽くす。

　強引な投げ。

en.html:
He pulled me down with him.
Locked together, we hit each other.


Hit.
Get hit.

Ichizo Sorimachi hated me.
I hated Ichizo Sorimachi.


Hit.

I hated him.
Hated this bloody man.

The reason had gone flying somewhere.

Hatred.
Nothing else. Only that.


Hit.

Hit.

Hit.

Hit.

At some point I was the only one still hitting.

Sorimachi did not move.
Getting hit, getting hit, and the bastard was laughing.

ja.html:
俺も諸共に引き倒された。
　組み合ったまま、殴り合う。


　殴る。
　殴られる。

　雪車町一蔵は俺を憎悪していた。
　俺は雪車町一蔵を憎悪していた。


　殴る。

　憎い。
　この男が憎い。

　理由は何処かに吹き飛んでいた。

　憎い。
　ただ憎い。


　殴る。

　殴る。

　殴る。

　殴る。

　いつしか、殴っているのは俺だけだった。

　雪車町は動かない。
　俺に殴られ、殴られながら笑っている。

en.html:
Sorimachi"Heh... hehe."
Sorimachi"Good face."
Sorimachi"Haan. Like that."
Sorimachi"So easy to understand now..."
Sorimachi"Hate me, no? Want to kill me?"
Sorimachi"Now you're trying to kill me... because you WANT to kill me."
Sorimachi"That's how it should be..."
Sorimachi"Before, it wasn't like that."
Sorimachi"Before, mann maar ke. Killing when you didn't want to..."
Sorimachi"Always the same, wasn't it?"
Sorimachi"What a bloody spectacle..."
Sorimachi"Kill somebody... then cry. All to say, 'Actually, I never wanted to do this.'"
Sorimachi"Toh mat kar, bhosdike. Then don't do it. Everybody you killed would tell you the same."
Sorimachi"Should've taken your cursed Muramasa and shut yourself away somewhere..."
Sorimachi"But no, you came barging out. For the world, to save more people, whatever it was—some great mission NOBODY ASKED YOU FOR. Took it on yourself, killed when you didn't want to... and cried."
Sorimachi"Absolute bakwaas."
Sorimachi"Kill people as you please, then feel sorry for YOURSELF..."
Sorimachi"Turns my bloody stomach."
Sorimachi"Makes me want to vomit."
Sorimachi"Now it's good."
Sorimachi"Good face."
Sorimachi"Hating and hating, wanting to kill so badly you can't stand it anymore. THAT face."
Sorimachi"Should've killed all of them like that."
Sorimachi"...Those Emishi kids also!"

ja.html:
雪車町「へっ……へへ」
雪車町「いい、面だ」
雪車町「それでいい」
雪車町「わっかりやすいぜぇ……」
雪車町「俺が憎くて、殺したいんだろう？」
雪車町「てめぇは今……俺を殺したくて、殺そうと してる」
雪車町「それでいいんだァ……」
雪車町「今までは、そうじゃなかった」
雪車町「てめぇは嫌々、殺してた……」
雪車町「いつも、そうだったんだろう？」
雪車町「みっともなかったぜぇ……」
雪車町「人を、殺しておいて…… 　本当はこんなことしたくなかったんだって 言いたくて、泣く」
雪車町「じゃあ、やるなってんだァ……。 　てめぇに殺された奴はみんな、そう言うぜ」
雪車町「呪いの村正つるぎを抱えてどっかに引き篭もって りゃあ良かった……」
雪車町「それを、てめぇはしゃしゃり出てきて…… 　世界のためだか、より多くの人を救うため だか、誰も頼んでねえ・・・・・・・使命を勝手に背負って、 本当は殺したくないくせに殺して……泣いた」
雪車町「くだらねえ」
雪車町「勝手に殺しておいて、自分を憐れみやがる たァ……」
雪車町「胸糞悪い」
雪車町「反吐が、出るぜ」
雪車町「今はいい」
雪車町「いい面だ」
雪車町「憎んで憎んで、殺したくて殺したくて堪ら なくて殺す面だァ」
雪車町「みんなそうやって、殺しゃあ良かった」
雪車町「……あの蝦夷の餓鬼共もなァ！」
